newsitem.title: USA: Medic Computer sees Q1 EPS below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Medic Computer sees Q1 EPS below estimates.

text.p: Medic Computer Systems Inc said Monday it expects to report first-quarter per share earnings of $0.14 to $0.18, below analysts' expectations of $0.27 and the year-ago $0.21.

The company also projected that first-quarter revenues would be below consensus estimates, with net revenues ranging from $47 million to $49 million, up from $43.37 million a year ago, after restatement for the acquisition of CompuSystems in May 1996, accounted for as a pooling of interests.
John McConnell, president and chief executive, said that after 15 successive quarters of meeting or exceeding analysts' forecasts, the expected decline in the first quarter is disappointing.

He attributes the drop in revenues to lower-than-expected systems sales, primarily in January and February, and the longer cycle for implementation of the larger MEDIC Vision systems. He said bookings in March have improved and are expected to include significant MEDIC Vision systems.
